clips.title: The story
paras: Senir Whitebeard is a dwarven dignitary and field agent stationed outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Serving as a special envoy from the Senate of Ironforge, he is tasked with monitoring the growing threats encircling Dun Morogh. His mission centers on evaluating the Frostmane troll offensive and reporting their movements directly back to the dwarven leadership.

While most travelers visit Kharanos for its bustling inn and famous stout, Senir Whitebeard is here on official business. As a representative sent directly by the Senate of Ironforge, his presence highlights how seriously the high halls take the destabilization of Dun Morogh. He serves as an essential bridge between local scouts facing danger on the snowy frontier and the legislators arguing policy behind the city's stone gates.

Senir's primary concern is the escalating aggression of the Frostmane trolls. Displaced and desperate in the frozen crags, the trolls have begun pushing dangerously close to dwarven settlements and roads. Rather than charging into battle himself, the venerable envoy gathers reconnaissance on troll positions, particularly around their stronghold, compiling meticulous reports so Ironforge's military commanders can strike decisively.
